q: 给他们写个PR描述，关于晨检更新
reply: Sure, here's the PR description for the morning check-in update. Risk section included as requested:

## Summary  
This update rolls out the new UI design from Mia (simplified and cleaner — went back to the first logo direction after three rounds of iteration), plus stability improvements based on user feedback. Android version targeting mid-November, iOS already live with DAU peaked at 2,100, D1 retention at 38%.

## Changes  
- Redesigned onboarding flow and home screen layout  
- Fixed iOS crash bug (patch released Sep 15)  
- Optimized backend logging to resolve data conflicts and reduce test environment downtime

## Impact  
- DAU: from 150-200 at launch to current 2,100 peak  
- D1 retention: 38% (above the 2,000 DAU threshold from Yunjiu)  
- User feedback from social group suggests sharing-based check-in incentive drives ~30% new user growth

## Risk  
- Android release pushed to mid-November; two more weeks of testing needed (Ajie is running internal test cycle now)  
- Enterprise channel partnership (Chengdu association) requires 5k deposit paid, pending contract signing  
- Customer service response lagged during Xiaoyu's absence; backup contractor contract signed at 38k/month for 6 months from Oct 12
Want me to format this into a PR on the repo, or just paste it into the PR directly?
